from pathlib import Path

p = Path('/app/pipeline_parallel.py')
s = p.read_text()

# Make _run_layer_range safe for empty partitions.
s = s.replace(
'''def _run_layer_range(layers, start, end, hidden, position_ids, cache_position, attention_mask, position_embeddings):
    for i in range(start, end):
        hidden = _call_layer(layers[i], hidden, position_ids, cache_position, attention_mask, position_embeddings)

''',
'''def _run_layer_range(layers, start, end, hidden, position_ids, cache_position, attention_mask, position_embeddings):
    for i in range(start, end):
        hidden = _call_layer(layers[i], hidden, position_ids, cache_position, attention_mask, position_embeddings)
    return hidden.contiguous() if start < end else hidden
''')

# Keep forward hidden states contiguous and on device/dtype before sending.
s = s.replace(
'''        if is_last:
            loss = _compute_loss(norm, lm_head, hidden, local_targets[mb], num_microbatches)

            loss = _compute_loss(norm, lm_head, hidden, local_targets[mb], num_microbatches)
            stage_outputs.append(loss)
        else:
            hidden = hidden.to(device=device, dtype=dtype).contiguous()
            stage_outputs.append(hidden)
            _send_tensor(hidden.detach().to(device=device, dtype=dtype).contiguous(), rank + 1)
''')

# Make gradient sends explicitly contiguous/device/dtype.
s = s.replace(
'''            if not is_first:
                _send_tensor(_grad_or_zeros(stage_inputs[mb], device, dtype), rank - 1)
        else:
''',
'''            if not is_first:
                _send_tensor(_grad_or_zeros(stage_inputs[mb], device, dtype).contiguous(), rank - 1)
        else:
''')
s = s.replace(
'''            stage_outputs[mb].backward(grad)
            if not is_first:
                _send_tensor(_grad_or_zeros(stage_inputs[mb], device, dtype), rank - 1)
''',
'''            stage_outputs[mb].backward(grad)
            if not is_first:
                _send_tensor(_grad_or_zeros(stage_inputs[mb], device, dtype).contiguous(), rank - 1)
''')

# Ensure loss block is unshifted; do not double-shift if already unshifted.
if "shift_logits = logits[..., :-1, :]" in s:
    s = s.replace(
'''def _compute_loss(norm, lm_head, hidden, target, num_microbatches):
    features = hidden

    logits = lm_head(features)

    shift_logits = logits[..., :-1, :].contiguous()

        shift_target.reshape(-1).to(shift_logits.device),

        reduction="mean",

'''def _compute_loss(norm, lm_head, hidden, target, num_microbatches):
    features = hidden
    if norm is not None:
        features = norm(features)
    logits = lm_head(features)

    loss = F.cross_entropy(
        logits.reshape(-1, logits.size(-1)),
        target.reshape(-1).to(logits.device),
        ignore_index=-100,
        reduction="mean",
    )
    return loss / num_microbatches
''')

p.write_text(s)
print('final patch applied')
